# Finds the current number of players in the games listed in appids
get_player_count <- function(appid) {
  r <- GET(
    "https://api.steampowered.com/ISteamUserStats/GetNumberOfCurrentPlayers/v1/",
    query = list(appid = appid)
  )
  stop_for_status(r)
  fromJSON(content(r, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))$response$player_count
}

counts <- tibble(appid = ap) |>
  mutate(players = sapply(appid, function(id) {
    Sys.sleep(1)
    get_player_count(id)
  }))

count


# Gets details about the game
get_store_details <- function(appid, currency = "us", language = "english") {
    url <- "https://store.steampowered.com/api/appdetails"
    resp <- GET(
      url, 
      query = list(
      appids = appid, 
      cc = currency,
      l = language)
    )
    stop_for_status(resp)
    data <- fromJSON(content(resp, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
    data
}

get_store_details(1222670)
get_store_details(4435490)$`4435490`$data$price_overview$final_formatted


# Uses Steamspy to grab the 100 most played games on Steam
get_steamspy <- function(request) {
  resp <- GET("https://steamspy.com/api.php",
  query = list(
    request = request
    )
  )
  stop_for_status(resp)
  games <- fromJSON(content(resp, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
  rows <- lapply(games, function(x) {
    tibble(appid = as.character(x$appid),
           name = x$name,
           price = (as.double(x$price))/100, 
           developer = x$developer,
           publisher = x$publisher,
           avg_playtime_forever = x$average_forever,
           avg_playtime_2weeks = x$average_2weeks)
  })
  steam_tib <- bind_rows(rows)
  steam_tib
}

top_forever <- get_steamspy("top100forever")
top_current <- get_steamspy("top100in2weeks")
top_owned <- get_steamspy("top100owned")

final_df <- bind_rows(top_forever, top_current) |>
  distinct(appid, .keep_all = TRUE)

final_df <- bind_rows(final_df, top_owned) |>
  distinct(appid, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  rename("app_id" = "appid")

# List of app ids to usse
app_id_list <- as.list(final_df$app_id)


# Empty tibble to add data to
game_data <- tibble(app_id = character(),
                    release = as.Date(character()),
                    metacritic = character(),
                    description = character()
                    )

# For loop to grab game data from each game in the app id list
for (temp_app_id in app_id_list_big) {
    Sys.sleep(1.5)
    temp_store_data = get_store_details(temp_app_id)
    game_data <- add_row(game_data,
            app_id = as.character(temp_store_data[[as.character(temp_app_id)]]$data$steam_appid),
            release = mdy(temp_store_data[[as.character(temp_app_id)]]$data$release_date$date),
            metacritic = as.character(temp_store_data[[as.character(temp_app_id)]]$data$metacritic$score),
            description = as.character(temp_store_data[[as.character(temp_app_id)]]$data$short_description)
           )
}
game_data

# Final tibble
final_df <- final_df |>
  left_join(game_data, by = "app_id")

### APP ID TIBBLE
```{r}
# APP ID TIBBLE!!!!
all_ids <- GET("https://api.steampowered.com/IStoreService/GetAppList/v1/",
               query = list(
                 key = steam_api_key,
                 include_games = TRUE,
                 include_dlc = FALSE,
                 include_software = FALSE,
                 max_result = 200
               )
              )
stop_for_status(all_ids)
apps_codes <- fromJSON(content(all_ids, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))

# Create the tibble from all of the app ids
steam_apps <- as_tibble(apps_codes$response$apps) |>
  select(appid, name) |>
  head(n = 200)

app_id_list <- as.list(steam_apps)[[1]]
```
